summary: Former Coast Range lookout on Bald (Hells) Mountain: a 1923 crow's nest and a 1934 cabin, gone by 1951; sources disagree on the administering agency.

facts.design: Cabin with a roof-level platform (1934); a short tower is noted in 1941
facts.status_note: Gone by 1951 per the register; firelookout.com says it was abandoned in 1951 and also lists it as destroyed; no source describes what remains
facts.agency: Oregon Department of Forestry (per the register; Rex's page places it in the Siuslaw National Forest)

events.note: Tree crow's nest with a log cabin for living quarters, per the register; firelookout.com gives the same 1923 crow's nest and log cabin
Cabin with an open platform on top, per the register; Rex's page describes a roof-level platform on a wooden frame in April 1934
Lookout reported to the Three Rivers Ranger Station through the Tri County Telephone Company
firelookout.com dates a frame cabin with a roof platform to 1936; the register gives 1934 for the cabin
Coast and Geodetic Survey recovery note calls the structure a short tower, also known as Hells Canyon Lookout
Register lists the lookout as removed in 1951; firelookout.com says abandoned in 1951 and also lists it as destroyed

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com give a 1923 crow's nest and log cabin. Rex's page begins with 1933 plans for a lookout house and 1934 accounts of a cabin and platform. None of the sources say whether a 1923 structure stood before the 1934 cabin, so the story gives both dates without choosing.

notes_for_editor: Agency conflict: the register and the record say Oregon Department of Forestry, while Rex's page (1933 and 1934 newspaper items, and a 1936 Forest Service station description) places the lookout in the Siuslaw National Forest with a Forest Service disk. The story reports both and does not resolve it. Build year conflict: the register and firelookout.com date a crow's nest to 1923, which Rex's page does not mention. The register says the cabin was built in 1934, and firelookout.com says 1936. Name: the sources call the site Hell Canyon or Bald Mtn. (Hells Canyon); the 1936 survey note says it is the same mountain as Sheridan Peak. County: the record says Yamhill, and Rex's 1933 item says the lookout is on the line between Tillamook and Yamhill counties; the 1941 note places it just east of the county line. The removal date rests on the register and firelookout.com; Rex's page has a Removed heading with no date. No source gives the current state of the site or its access. Oregon Digital images titled Bald Mountain from Lane County concern a different site and were excluded.
